short_description:
Where to find the white fox, one of GTA 6's unique ("Snapmatic") animals: around Howe Dairy, east of Port Gellhorn, in the woods north of the Emerald River (a small area boxed in by roads). It only spawns after Bret Vogel texts you its clue (his hunting questline starts after you meet him in Chapter 2). Guides list its payout at $10,500 to $18,250. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #17 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: Insider Gaming, Mobalytics, PowerPyx.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).

El zorro blanco de GTA 6 vive cerca de Howe Dairy, al este de Port Gellhorn, en el bosque al norte del Emerald River. Solo aparece después de que Bret te mande su pista (desde el capítulo 2). Las guías dicen que paga entre 10.500 y 18.250 dólares. Fuentes: Insider Gaming, Mobalytics, PowerPyx.
